bio: I'm a Master's student in Computer Science and Information Technology at Ca' Foscari University of Venice, holding a Bachelor's degree in Software Development from Istanbul Aydin University.

I'm passionate about software engineering, iOS mobile app development, and artificial intelligence. My practical work spans building native iOS apps with Swift and SwiftUI, conducting machine learning research on explanation stability (SHAP), and developing embedded systems with ESP32.
Currently, I'm working as a Mobile Application Developer & Software Project Coordinator at Akıllı Otomat, and I'm eager to connect with engineering teams to build impactful technology.
